subject: planner: move base plan related output of core pkg and make it well-pkged (#52529)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent: introduces `pkg/planner/core/base` with `Plan`/`PhysicalPlan`/`Task` interfaces (matching prior `pkg/planner/core/plan_base.go`/`task_base.go`) and rewires planner/executor/session call sites to use the new package. Spot-checked key runtime-sensitive paths updated here (plan cache rebuild/type assertions in `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go`, EXPLAIN/plan encoding in `pkg/planner/core/common_plans.go` and `pkg/planner/core/encode.go`, and multi-stmt point-plan prefetch in `pkg/server/conn.go`); changes appear mechanical with no plausible Blocker/High impact to SQL semantics, transaction/session behavior, or correctness.
